# Baseline task calibration pilot

Status: preparation in progress; no scored participant dispatched.

Authorized September 22 in PR #125. Four new task candidates, two fresh baseline
sessions per task, ordinary sources plus original AGENTS, generated RI unavailable.
This calibrates task difficulty after the previous score ceiling. It does not
compare conditions or establish RI benefit. See [protocol](PROTOCOL.md).

Task authoring and independent preflight precede the immutable input freeze.
Each completed first outcome will be published separately. Earlier study evidence
and production guidance remain unchanged. The PR remains Draft.
